title: AS2: for..in loop and delete operator
description: Verify for..in loops and the delete operator compile correctly in the AS2 compiler. for..in uses ActionEnumerate2 (0x55). delete uses ActionDelete (0x3a) for named props or ActionDelete2 (0x3b) for local vars. Tests: for(var k in obj) compiles and contains 0x55, delete obj.prop compiles with 0x3a, delete localVar with 0x3b.
